idea-plugin.name: MavenUp
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ plugin for Maven projects to simplify dependency and plugin management. It provides a clear table view of all declared components and enables easy updates to newer versions.

Features:
  • Dependency & Plugin Overview: Displays dependencies and plugins from all Maven modules, including entries from dependencyManagement and pluginManagement.
  • Property-Aware Versions: Shows Maven properties such as ${spring.version} and updates the shared property instead of replacing its references.
  • Repository-Based Update Check: Finds newer versions in Maven Central and configured private repositories, including authenticated repositories from settings.xml.
  • Flexible Version Selection: Select versions from a dropdown, optionally hide unstable releases, and update the affected pom.xml files after confirmation.
  • Navigation & Context Menu: Jump directly to the definition in the pom.xml via double-click (or optional single-click). The Open on [browser] button (placed directly after Refresh) becomes active once a dependency row is selected; its label shows the configured repository browser name and opens the current version in that browser. Right-click any dependency row for a context menu with Navigate to pom.xml, Open in Maven Repository, or Show Vulnerability Details.
  • Configurable Repository Browser: Choose between MVN Repository and Sonatype Central for artifact version links — applies to both the main table context menu and the Vulnerability Details dialog.
  • Multi-Source Vulnerability Check: Checks direct components and resolved transitive dependencies through OSV.dev, with optional Maven-focused enrichment from Sonatype OSS Index.
  • Detailed Security Findings: Shows deduplicated advisories with severity/CVSS, summaries, sources, references, and clearly marked transitive findings. The Vulnerability Details button is enabled only when a dependency row with findings is selected and opens the findings for that selected dependency. In the details dialog, row-based actions Open in ... and References... become available after selecting a finding, and right-clicking the selected row in any column except References offers both repository navigation and direct opening of advisory references.
  • Secure OSS Index Access: Stores API tokens in IntelliJ Password Safe and provides a direct link to the Sonatype account page for obtaining a token.
  • Project Settings: Configure navigation, automatic version selection, unstable-version filters, transitive scans, and optional OSS Index integration under Settings | Tools | MavenUp.
Background processing and a layered internal architecture keep long-running operations responsive and maintainable.
